notes: S5-HVS1: The only individually named star studied in the paper. It is classified as follow_up because T:p2-b1 describes it as a previously discovered HVS candidate (Koposov et al. 2020), and the paper then uses it in its analysis (e.g. T:p8-b8). The supplied material gives no Gaia source ID for S5-HVS1.

S5-HVS1: T:p8-b8 reports S5-HVS1's “Galactocentric velocity” as v_ej ≃ 1750 km s−1; this is recorded under galactic_rest_frame_velocity as the total Galactic-frame speed. No other target quantities are reported for this star.
